```{r}
odds <- seq(from=1,to=19,by=2)
evenly_spaced <- seq(from=0,to=1,length.out=5)

print(odds)
print(evenly_spaced)
```
```{r}
repeat_A <- rep("A",times=4)
repeat_each <- rep(c("A","B"),each=2)
repeat_sequence <- rep(c("A","B"),times=2)

print(repeat_A)
print(repeat_each)
print(repeat_sequence)
```

Question#2
The each argument repeats every element a specified number of times before moving to the next element. The times argument repeats the entire vector.
